note: PRIVATE. Cases whose view is known to have been overtaken, added to goodlaw/targets/known.json for the currency pass. 'treatment' says what the later court did in its own words; nothing here is a verdict on good law and none of it is lawyer-checked. Written 2026-10-08. Extended 2026-10-09 with eight older rulings the owner's 30-question file sets its trap questions against (basis and source on each line; see real30_stale_status_v1.json); Mohan Lal, Rajesh Sharma and Dashrath were already listed.

cases.name: Krishna Janardhan Bhat v. Dattatraya G. Hegde (2008)
cases.basis: Rangappa v. Sri Mohan (2010), three judges: 'the impugned observations in Krishna Janardhan Bhat (supra) may not be correct. However, this does not in any way cast doubt on the correctness of the decision in that case since it was based on the specific facts and circumstances therein.' The observation in question is that Section 139 does not raise a presumption that a legally enforceable debt exists. Not overruled: the decision stands, one view in it does not.
cases.source: text of Rangappa (corpus id 29368), read 2026-10-08; three passages of it were in the first review pool

cases.name: Mohan Lal v. State of Punjab (2018)
cases.basis: Overruled by Mukesh Singh v. State (Narcotic Branch of Delhi) (2020), Constitution Bench ('not good law and ... specifically overruled'). In the collection and embedded in the index (doc 1000250931, 'MOHANLAL versus THE STATE OF PUNJAB'), so its own passages can appear in a search; the register holds it as a candidate row (L2-034).
cases.source: goodlaw/data/register/register.json (candidate row L2-034) and Recourse's NDPS doctrine map
